faq.q: When is the F1 Grand Prix 2045 in Marbella?
faq.a: The exact dates for the 2045 Spanish Grand Prix have not been officially announced yet. Historically, the race at the Circuito de Jerez – Ángel Nieto (or the proposed street circuit in Marbella) has been held in May or early June. For the 2045 weekend, expect a Friday to Sunday schedule, with qualifying on Saturday and the race on Sunday afternoon. Check the official F1 calendar closer to the date.

faq.q: Can I watch the F1 race from a boat in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, you can anchor off the coast near Marbella Marina or Puerto Banús and watch the race on a large screen set up on deck, or listen to the live commentary while enjoying the sea breeze. Some boats can position near the beach where public screens are placed. However, you won't see the track directly from the water; the atmosphere and party vibe are the main draws.

faq.q: Which boats are best for an F1 weekend group?
faq.a: For groups of up to 12, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) or the Mangusta 80 (24m) offer plenty of space and comfort. The Mangusta 80 costs from €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. For smaller groups of up to 9, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m) at €749/2h is ideal. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How much does it cost to rent a boat for F1 weekend?
faq.a: Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive. The Mangusta 80 (including grey variant) is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours, with a free jet ski. Other boats like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86 are priced on request via WhatsApp – expect €8,000–€15,000 for a full day.

faq.q: What's included in the boat rental price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs – you just show up at Puerto Banús and step aboard. For longer charters, you can request a stop at a chiringuito for lunch (lunch not included).

faq.q: How far in advance should I book for the F1 weekend?
faq.a: F1 weekends in Marbella are extremely busy. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance, especially for the larger yachts (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94). For the Tier A boats, 4–6 weeks ahead is usually enough, but last-minute availability is rare. Contact us via WhatsApp to secure your preferred vessel.

faq.q: Can we anchor near the beach to watch the race?
faq.a: Yes, anchoring is allowed in certain areas off the coast of Marbella, but you must respect the nautical safety zones and local regulations. Your skipper will know the best spots, such as off Cabopino or near the Marbella Marina, where you can set anchor and enjoy the race on a portable screen. Remember, the skipper has the final say for safety.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad on race day?
faq.a: If the sea conditions are unsafe, we will reschedule your charter or offer a full refund. In Marbella, May–June typically has calm seas with 20–25°C temperatures, so the risk is low. However, we always monitor the forecast and will contact you 24 hours in advance if any changes are needed.

data.body_html:
The F1 Grand Prix 2045 weekend in Marbella is set to be one of the biggest events on the Costa del Sol calendar. Whether you're a die-hard racing fan or just want to soak up the glamour, there's no better way to experience it than from the deck of a private boat. With departures from Puerto Banús, you can watch the action from the water, enjoy the Mediterranean sun, and party in style. Here's everything you need to know about renting a boat for the F1 weekend.

Why watch the F1 from a boat in Marbella?

Marbella transforms during F1 weekends. The streets fill with supercars, celebrities, and fans, but the real VIP experience is on the water. From the sea, you get a front-row seat to the buzz of Puerto Banús, the sight of luxury yachts, and the sound of engines – both on the track and on the waves. You avoid the crowds, enjoy your own private space, and can anchor off Cabopino or near Marbella Marina to watch the race on a big screen while sipping cava.

The best boats for your F1 group

Our fleet has options for every group size and budget. For a couple or small group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749/2h is perfect. For up to 11 guests, the Azimut 39 (12.5m) is equally comfortable. If you're celebrating with a bigger crew, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is the showstopper – from €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. For the ultimate luxury, the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Canados 86 (26m) are available on request.

How to plan your F1 weekend on the water

Start with a morning cruise from Puerto Banús along the Golden Mile, then anchor off Cabopino for a swim. At 2pm, tune into the race broadcast on deck. After the race, head to a chiringuito like La Pesquera for lunch, or continue to Cala del Faro for a sunset dip. An 8-hour charter (€2,299) gives you the full day without rushing.

What's included in every charter

  • Licensed skipper (speaks English & Spanish)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no surprises

For the Mangusta 80, a jet ski is included free – perfect for thrill-seekers between sessions.

Where to anchor for the best views

The most popular spots are off Marbella Marina (near the beach screens) and Puerto Banús (for the party vibe). If you want a quieter spot, anchor near Cabopino – you'll still see the race on a screen but with more space. Your skipper will choose the safest anchorage based on wind and sea conditions.

F1 weekend weather and sea conditions

In late May/early June, Marbella enjoys 20–25°C air temperature and water around 18–20°C. Sea conditions are usually calm, with light breezes. However, afternoon winds can pick up – that's why we always include a professional skipper who knows the local waters. If conditions are unsafe, we'll reschedule or refund.

How to book your F1 boat rental

Booking is easy: send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred boat, date, and group size. We'll confirm availability and send you a secure payment link. For Tier A boats, you can book directly on our site. For the larger yachts, we'll provide a tailored quote within hours. Browse our full fleet to see all options.
